create.name: Francisco Morillo Gable
create.bio:
Francisco Morillo Gable is an Insight meditation teacher whose work is grounded in the early Buddhist discourses and the Theravada canon. Born in the Dominican Republic, he moved to the United States as a boy and built a career as a senior director in San Francisco's technology industry until a serious accident in 2003 changed the course of his life and led him to meditation. He trained as a Dharma teacher in the classical programme of the Insight Meditation Center in Redwood City, and he leads retreats and courses at the Insight Meditation Society and the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies in Massachusetts and at centres in California.

He is especially committed to teaching in Spanish and to making the practice welcoming for disabled, queer and other under-served communities. In 2026 he became principal teacher of the Centro de Meditación Insight, a new non-profit that offers the Insight tradition to Spanish speakers through live online courses and silent retreats, run on a sliding scale with teachings given for dana. His teaching also draws on the arts and on qigong.

courses.title: Las prácticas fundamentales de la visión clara y profunda (Insight)
courses.description: An eight-week live online course in Spanish, two hours each Wednesday evening (Central European Time), on the core meditation instructions of the Insight tradition: breath, body, emotions and thoughts. Classes mix teaching, guided practice and small-group discussion.

courses.title: Quietud y Claridad: Retiro de Insight
courses.description: A four-day silent residential retreat near Madrid on calm and insight practice from early Buddhism, for people with some meditation experience. Guided and independent sittings alternate, with question time and small-group meetings; lodging is paid separately at the venue and teachings are offered for dana.
courses.price: €288 EUR registration (plus €231 EUR board and lodging)

free_resources.title: Presentación del Centro de Meditación Insight (recording)
free_resources.description: The recorded launch session of his Spanish-language centre, with meditation, conversation about the Insight lineage and guests including Rebecca Bradshaw. The recording is sent free on request through the centre's form.
